name: select_workspace
description: Set or clear the active workspace for all subsequent MCP operations (generations, balance, transactions, uploads, custom references). To select a workspace, pass `workspace_id` from `list_workspaces`. To clear the current selection and return to the default private workspace, pass `clear: true`. The selection persists across sessions and clients until changed or cleared. Returns an error if the workspace doesn't exist or the user isn't a member.

workspace_id.description: Workspace UUID from `list_workspaces`. Required unless `clear` is true.

clear.description: When true, clear the selected workspace instead of selecting one.
